# Sales listing copy: The AI Website Copy Kit

Draft for your sales page (Gumroad, Payhip, Instamojo, your own site). Every claim below matches what is actually in the kit. Add real testimonials only once you have them, with permission.

## Title
The AI Website Copy Kit: 50 Ready-to-Use AI Prompts for Better Website Content

## One-line pitch
Fifty copy-and-paste prompts, a reusable client brief and a quality checklist, so you can turn real business facts into website copy you can check and edit.

## Short description (for listing cards, about 250 characters)
50 prompts across 10 website-copy categories, a reusable client brief, a worked example and a quality checklist. For freelance designers, developers, small agencies and small-business owners. PDF, Word and plain-text files included.

## Full description

**Stuck at "Lorem ipsum"?** The design is approved, the build works, and the page still has no words. This kit gives you a structured way to write them with an AI chat assistant, without getting made-up facts back.

**What you get**
- **50 prompts in 10 categories:** homepage and hero, About and credibility, service and product pages, calls to action, social proof, SEO and local pages, blog content, brand voice and editing, design handoff and UX copy, and client workflow.
- **Clear instructions for every prompt:** when to use it, which [PLACEHOLDERS] to fill in, and a tip.
- **A reusable client and business brief:** fill it once and it feeds every prompt. A fillable Word version is included.
- **A "Fact Guard" built into every prompt:** it tells the AI to use only the facts you give it and to flag gaps instead of guessing. It reduces invented details but does not remove the need to check.
- **A quick-start guide and a "which prompt do I need?" finder.**
- **A complete worked example** for a fictional neighbourhood bakery, from brief to reviewed copy.
- **A website-copy quality checklist** to run before anything goes live.

**Files included**
- 80-page PDF with clickable contents
- Editable Word version of the full kit
- Fillable client brief (Word)
- Plain-text prompt library for clean copy-paste

**Who it is for**
Freelance web designers and developers who need real copy before launch; small agencies that want a repeatable way to brief and edit copy; small-business owners writing their own site.

**Good to know**
- Works with any modern AI chat assistant (for example ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini). Results vary by tool, and every draft needs a human read and fact check.
- The kit helps you write drafts. It does not promise rankings, traffic or sales, and it is not legal or compliance advice.
- Single-user licence: use it for your own business and your clients' sites. No resale or redistribution.

**Price:** ₹499

## FAQ for the page
**Which AI tool do I need?** Any chat assistant. A free plan is enough to start, though limits and quality vary by tool.
**Do I need to be a writer?** No. The prompts do the structuring; you supply the facts and do the final edit.
**Can I use it for client work?** Yes, for your clients' websites. You may not resell or share the kit itself.
**Is it a template pack I can edit in Canva?** The PDF is the finished product. A Canva page plan is not part of the buyer files; keep it for your own use.
**Will it make my site rank or convert better?** No promises. It gives you a clearer process and a checklist to catch weak or unsupported copy.

## Before publishing
Check the licence wording, add your name/brand, and confirm your payment platform's rules for digital products and tax in India.
